agency.name: FitPulse AI
agency.client: Small and mid-size fitness clubs, gyms and boutique studios without an in-house marketing team

employees.name: Maya
employees.title: Project Manager (Chief of Staff)
responsibilities: Audits the work of all 7 employees
Assigns, splits and tracks tasks
Keeps the Google Sheet ledger up to date
Emails the Boss a daily status summary
Answers the Boss's questions in the dashboard chat from live data
employees.inputs: Tasks and questions from the Boss; status and outputs from all 7 employees; the ledger
employees.outputs: Task assignments, ledger rows, daily email report, chat answers, weekly summary
kpis: Share of tasks completed on time

employees.name: Leo
employees.title: Lead Researcher
responsibilities: Finds local prospects for the club: nearby companies for corporate memberships, communities, partners
Qualifies each prospect and records where it was found
Passes qualified leads to the Sales and Booking Agent
employees.inputs: Target area and audience from the Project Manager; inbound trial requests from the website form
employees.outputs: Leads with name, company, contact, source and status
kpis: Share of leads with a verified source

employees.name: Sofia
employees.title: Sales and Booking Agent
responsibilities: Follows up every new lead with a personal message
Answers inquiries about prices, schedule and trial visits
Books free trial visits and updates the lead status
employees.inputs: New leads from the Lead Researcher and the website form
employees.outputs: Follow-up messages, trial booking proposals, updated lead statuses

employees.name: Carter
employees.title: Content Creator
responsibilities: Writes social media posts, Reels scripts and workout tips
Adapts each piece to the platform (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram)
Hands finished drafts to the Social Media Publisher
employees.inputs: Content briefs from the Project Manager; club offers, schedule and news
employees.outputs: Post drafts with platform, title, text and hashtags
kpis: Share of drafts approved without edits

employees.name: Piper
employees.title: Social Media Publisher
responsibilities: Takes approved drafts from the Content Creator
Publishes to released channels and schedules the rest for Boss approval
Records platform, link and time of every published post
employees.inputs: Post drafts from the Content Creator; channel releases from the Boss
employees.outputs: Published posts with platform, link and time; posts waiting for approval

employees.name: Riley
employees.title: Retention Specialist
responsibilities: Prepares win-back campaigns for members who stopped attending
Writes renewal reminders and loyalty offers
Flags churn risks to the Project Manager
employees.inputs: Member segments and attendance notes from the club; booked trials from Sales
employees.outputs: Win-back messages, renewal reminders, churn risk notes

employees.name: Remy
employees.title: Reputation Manager
responsibilities: Drafts replies to reviews on Google Maps and Yelp
Prepares review request messages for happy members
Escalates serious complaints to the Project Manager
employees.inputs: Reviews and complaints passed by the Boss or the Project Manager
employees.outputs: Review replies, review request messages, escalations

employees.name: Avery
employees.title: Performance Analyst
responsibilities: Turns the ledger into daily and weekly performance insights
Tracks local competitors' prices and offers
Flags bottlenecks and blocked work to the Project Manager
employees.inputs: Ledger data, leads, posts and outputs of every employee
employees.outputs: Performance insights, competitor notes, bottleneck flags

routines.title: Daily lead research
routines.description: Find 5 new local prospects for the client club (nearby companies for corporate memberships, communities or partners). Record name, company, contact, source and source URL for each.

routines.title: Daily content drafts
routines.description: Write 2 social media post drafts for today: one Instagram post with a workout tip and one Telegram post about the club's free trial visit.

routines.title: Publish today's posts
routines.description: Take every draft post and publish it to the released channels. Send the rest to the Boss for approval.

routines.title: Follow up new leads
routines.description: Prepare a personal follow-up message with a free trial offer for every lead with status New.

routines.title: Win-back campaign
routines.description: Prepare 3 win-back messages for members who have not visited in 30 days: one friendly check-in, one offer, one last reminder.

routines.title: Review request messages
routines.description: Prepare 2 short messages asking happy members to leave a Google Maps review, and 1 template reply to a negative review about crowded peak hours.

routines.title: Daily performance insights
routines.description: Analyse today's ledger: what was completed, what is blocked and why, which KPI moved. Give 3 short insights and 1 recommendation for tomorrow.
